title: Leading QCD-induced four-loop contributions to the beta-function of the Higgs self-coupling in the SM
claim: Leading four-loop terms y_t^4 g_s^6 in beta_lambda (eq. (11)), y_t g_s^8 in beta_yt (eq. (12)) and y_t^2 g_s^6 in the Higgs anomalous dimension (eq. (13)), in QCD + top Yukawa. Only diagrams with external H are kept, so gamma5 (which appears only in chi and phi+- Yukawa vertices) is avoided completely.
theory: QCD + top Yukawa (electroweak gauge couplings, lambda, other Yukawas neglected)
scheme: DREG, MS-bar, massive tadpoles; gamma5 never enters
symmetry_argument: choice of external Higgs legs avoids gamma5; standard DR action principle (modulo axial anomalies)

proved: explicit results; agreement with Martin's effective-potential result (eq. (4.32) of Martin 2015) and vacuum-energy relation (eq. (30)); gamma_0 = gamma_m^SS/12 (eq. (36))

red_flags: gamma5-free by construction; it says nothing about the gamma5-sensitive 4-loop SM terms
cross_checks: S. Martin 4-loop effective potential at leading QCD order (as cited)
notes: Example of the standard trick of choosing external legs/sectors so that gamma5-odd traces never arise.
